title: Practice After Daily
user: Special-interest daily-puzzle players who want the shared daily challenge but also a no-pressure practice run that teaches the domain after they finish.

evidence.quote_or_summary: GeneGuessr’s creator explains that practice mode unlocks after the daily puzzle; a commenter asks how to enable it and whether it offers more hints and guesses for newcomers.
GeneGuessr is a live daily protein-guessing web game, validating a niche-knowledge daily format and revealing the discoverability cost of hidden practice.

recurrence: The maker built practice because a daily-only puzzle excludes learning; a separate player immediately needed clearer access and gentler rules.
current_workaround: Google explanations, wait for another daily, or give up after an opaque specialized puzzle.
incumbents_and_gap: GeneGuessr and subject-specific daily puzzles prove that a domain can sustain a ritual, but practice is often secondary or locked behind the main solve.
smallest_useful_product: A daily 'Signal Garden' classification puzzle: infer a fictional ecosystem from compact traits, receive semantic feedback, then choose an openly visible practice seed with optional hints and a short explanation. Non-goals: real biology claims, scraped datasets, classroom dashboards, or LLM answers.
success_measure: At least 30% of daily starters use practice, and practice users have a 20-point higher next-day completion rate than non-practice users.
monetization: free — educational clarity and sharing matter more than gating hints; a donation link is sufficient for v1.
constraints: Use fictional/generated taxonomy to avoid misinformation; show accessible explanations; local anonymous progress only; no health or scientific advice.
why_distinct: The practice loop is visible from the start and is part of the game’s learning design, not a buried consolation mode.
